description: One ledger, two readers: src-tauri/os/cairn-common/src/executor_protocol_ledger.rs (build.rs and the landing binder) and scripts/lib/executor-protocol-headings.ts (the authoring check and the publication scripts). `derivation` is what EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION derives to from a file's doc block (null: refused). `cases` is the landing rule: the protocol file on the branch, already containing the destination, and at the destination; ok says whether the branch may land, and bindsTo is the version its one authored heading takes (null when it authors none). Both test suites read this table, so the two cannot drift.

derivation.name: the highest bound heading
a NEXT heading is one above the highest
two NEXT headings derive nothing
the highest heading, not the count, across a gap
only the anchor's own doc block counts
indented docs and mid-sentence mentions are not headings
a version's digits are read whole
a Versions record line is not a heading
NEXT is a whole word
a block with no heading derives nothing
derivation.source:
/// The protocol version.
pub const EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32 = derived::EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION;

derivation.name: a file with no constant derives nothing

cases.name: a branch that authors no heading binds nothing
a NEXT paragraph binds one above the destination
a hand-numbered paragraph on the next number keeps it
a hand-numbered paragraph that collided is rebound
a stale hand number is rebound
two authored paragraphs are refused
two NEXT paragraphs are refused
rewording an inherited heading mints nothing
rewording a heading while adding another under its number is refused
a no-bump note binds nothing
a stale branch that never touched the block binds nothing
cases.branch:
/// Version 140 is main's.
pub const EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32 = derived::EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION;

cases.name: a Versions record line mints nothing
an indented doc line is a field's docs, not a paragraph
a version mentioned mid-sentence is not a paragraph
a destination that carries NEXT is refused
a branch with no constant fails closed
